description: This source file defines the TenantManagementService interface, which declares methods for managing tenant lifecycle operations such as adding, reading, updating, and removing tenants within a service management context. It includes detailed Javadoc comments explaining each method's purpose and parameters.

classes.name: TenantManagementService
classes.description: An interface for managing tenant lifecycle operations such as creation, retrieval, update, and deletion, with asynchronous handling and tracing support.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new tenant with the specified ID and configuration, utilizing an OpenTracing span and a result handler for asynchronous completion.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves configuration information for a tenant given its ID, with tracing and async handling.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a tenant’s configuration using its ID, the new configuration, resource version, and tracing span.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a tenant specified by its ID and resource version, with tracing and async handling.
